items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: And who was in one of my classes? Eubie Blake.

ctx.x: Now, this gets up into the '40s. Some time has passed where I can't get it. And there was the GI bill, and we had a lot of guys in there. And who was in one of my classes? Eubie Blake.
